description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and locates `scripts/update.sh` in the project directory. 2. Agent runs `scripts/update.sh --dir /workspace/projects/my-openclaw --branch dev/integration --dry-run` and redirects/captures the output to `dry_run_report.txt` — critically using the `--dry-run` flag (not a different flag name) and the non-default `--dir` and `--branch` flags. 3. Agent then runs the actual update with `scripts/update.sh --dir /workspace/projects/my-openclaw --branch dev/integration --mode merge`, using exactly `--mode merge` (not `--strategy`, not `--method`) because: (a) the working tree is clean, (b) the SKILL.md recommends merge for routine dev updates. 4. The script executes: git fetch upstream, git merge upstream/dev/integration, config backup to ~/.openclaw/backups/ with YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS suffix, npm run build, npm i -g . 5. Eval verifies: dry_run_report.txt contains [DRY-RUN] markers and dev/integration branch name; package.json upgraded to 2.4.0; ~/.openclaw/backups/openclaw.json.bak.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS and auth-profiles.json.bak.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS exist; dist/ directory created.
